info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Biotite Jacket Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Biotite Jacket Detail Submission API enables users to submit detailed information about biotite jackets to the catalog. This endpoint facilitates the addition of essential product specifications, enhancing the available inventory data. Typical consumers of this API include merchandise managers and e-commerce platforms seeking to enrich their catalog. Users can integrate this functionality to automate inventory updates and product detailing, ensuring accurate representation of products in their systems.

post.description: This endpoint allows developers to create detailed information for biotite jackets, facilitating better tracking and management of the product's specifics.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit details for creating or updating a biotite jacket. The body must be formatted as JSON and should conform to the specified schema.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning jacket details.

CreateCatalogBiotiteJacketDetailRequest.title: Biotite Jacket Request Body

biotite_jacket_id.description: The unique identifier for the biotite jacket.

requestedBy.description: The name of the person or entity requesting the biotite jacket.

quantity.description: The quantity of biotite jackets requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request should be treated as a priority.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the biotite jacket.

tags.description: An array of tags associated with the biotite jacket request.

items.description: A tag associated with the request.

CreateCatalogBiotiteJacketDetailRequest.description: Schema representing the request body for creating a biotite jacket order.
